entries.title: A merge card shows a crewmate's new push within a minute
entries.body: When a crewmate pushes a new version under a merge card you have not answered yet, the card now shows that version's checks within a minute of the crewmate finishing, rather than keeping the earlier version's passed checks for up to five minutes.
entries.noPicture: The card looks as it always did; what changed is how soon it picks up a push.
